Re-planned: 101 bays on 1.80 ha; full set
All external doors: pressed-steel frames, HDG + powder-coat; door heads at 2 100 unless noted.
Frames: HDG steel, powder-coat Charcoal, integral burglar bars, insect mesh to ablution vents. * above gatehouse FFL (+0.900).
Ceramic tiles full height to 2 400, PVA above
Plaster + scrubbable acrylic PVA; 1 200 dado tiles
Panic bar (EN 1125) both leaves, overhead closers, flush bolts, kick plates, SS pull handles
Lever on rose (SS 304), 3-lever sashlock, overhead closer, door stop
Lever on rose, 2-lever lock, rubber stop
5-lever deadlock + lever, hinged steel security gate with padlock hasp
D-pull + rail (SANS 10400-S), privacy bolt with emergency release, 'Accessible' sign
Vitreous china, 6/3 L dual flush, heavy-duty seat
Under-counter / wall-hung, sensor or lever taps
Push-button timed mixer, anti-vandal head, TMV 41 °C
